meta.purpose: Ops noun senses that Wiktionary computing topics omit. Headwords are ontology target words only (status, latency); no held-out word (lag, health, state, response, time, ...) is authored here and no gloss mentions one (enforced by tests/test_noun_gloss_sense.py). Definitional glosses only.

senses.gloss: The current operational condition of a service or component.
The delay between sending a call and receiving the answer.
